Election Commission Responds to Dissent Report Amidst Opposition Calls

The Election Commission of India has responded to an investigation report, stating that "Differing views and observations are a normal part of deliberation in any institution." This statement comes after reports of dissent within the commission, with the opposition demanding the removal of an official identified as Gyanesh. The commission clarified that decisions are made unanimously by the full commission.
